subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: After repairing write-time authorization, should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` calls reject legacy ownerless rows as having no plugin authority?
rationale: Exact equality is the security-conservative policy, but it intentionally changes access to persisted rows created before plugin ownership metadata existed.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide explicit upgrade documentation and proof.

options.title: Migrate trusted ownership
options.body: Migrate only legacy rows whose plugin owner can be established securely before enforcing equality.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and provide explicit upgrade documentation and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest broad history signal across the affected session storage and Gateway surfaces.
